claims.quote: A missense mutation c.1220C>G of KCN2A gene was recently identified in an infant with epilepsy.
A missense mutation c.1220C>G of KCN2A gene
mutant KV1.2_P407R subunits formed loss-of-function channels
suppressed both KV1.2 and KV1.1 channel activities
expression of human KV1.2_P407R in early postnatal rat cortical neurons

claims.object_text: Gapmer antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) targeted to c.1220C>G mutation
claims.quote: We hypothesize that Gapmer antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) targeted to c.1220C>G mutation will selectively degrade the mutant mRNA while allowing the remaining wild-type (WT) subunits to form functional channels.

claims.object_text: Gapmer antisense oligonucleotides delivered in lipid nanoparticle
claims.quote: As a proof of principle, delivery of Gapmer packaged in lipid nanoparticle into cortical neurons selectively suppressed KV1.2_P407R over the WT protein expression, reversing the broadening of action potential duration, abrogating the EAD and leading to overall increase in potassium current.
